user.title: Connect to GeoPulse
user.description: Enter your GeoPulse server and a user API token (GeoPulse → Settings → API Tokens). The token has full access to your GeoPulse account.

import_selection.title: Import from GeoPulse
import_selection.description:
Choose what to bring into Home Assistant as device trackers. Only the current position is imported; history stays in GeoPulse.

GeoPulse can't tell apart two devices that use the same source type (for example two phones both on OwnTracks), so they appear as one tracker for that type. Friends are listed only if they share their live location with you.

data.import_aggregate_account: Whole account (latest position from any source)

export_selection.title: Export to GeoPulse
export_selection.description: Choose Home Assistant device trackers to send to GeoPulse. Trackers created by this integration aren't offered. Next, you'll get one screen per tracker to set its device ID and the GeoPulse account (token) it goes to.

export_device_ids.title: Export tracker {index} of {total}
export_device_ids.description:
**{entity}**

GeoPulse keeps one timeline per account and doesn't separate devices within it, so each person needs their own GeoPulse account. Enter the Home Assistant location source token from the account this tracker belongs to (in that account: Settings → Location Sources → Home Assistant).

data_description.device_id: Label GeoPulse stores with each point. Must be unique within one GeoPulse account.
data_description.token: From the GeoPulse account this tracker belongs to. Trackers of the same person can share a token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GeoPulse
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {base_url} was rejected. Enter a new token for the same GeoPulse account.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach GeoPulse at that URL.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant logs.

error.nothing_selected: Select at least one thing to import or export.

abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different GeoPulse account.

**{entity}**

GeoPulse keeps one timeline per account and doesn't separate devices within it, so each person needs their own GeoPulse account. Enter the Home Assistant location source token from the account this tracker belongs to (in that account: Settings → Location Sources → Home Assistant).

data_description.recorder_exclude: Keeps GeoPulse the only store of location history. Excluded entities also don't appear in the logbook or long-term statistics.

export_auth_failed.title: GeoPulse export token rejected
export_auth_failed.description: GeoPulse rejected the location source token used for {entities} ({title}), so exporting them has stopped. Points are kept in the retry queue if it's enabled. Check the Home Assistant location source in that person's GeoPulse account and enter its token again under the integration's options → Export selection.
